digest.component_or_area: code quality remediation / static analysis findings
propositions: Environment inheritance bug in reconcile_helpers.py and run_differs.py where REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off is not explicitly controlled on the live sync path; fix requires building explicit env dict and stripping the key when no_sync=False.

Dead capability flag _HAVE_ASTGREP defined but unused in test_conformance.py and test_coverage_reconstruction.py must be removed; retained in test_engine_b.py where it is legitimately skipif-referenced.
Input-contract validation is category-agnostic; test_validation_depth.py needs a non-review (transform category) test to prove this.
BatchRunner.run signature must make agent_runner parameter optional across base, Default, and CodeReview variants to match ProductionBatchRunner and maintain mypy override consistency.

Tier-2 dead symbols verified unused across multiple files must be removed: reverse maps in reconcile_check.py, fixture constants in test helpers, orphaned imports in reads.py, and nested dead function in test_overlap_judge.py.
